finding: F2 selection record section 12.5 row 2; 05-work-agents-skills.md section 9
case: A checker whose delivered inputs include the producer's rationale field, detected by the loader's record and not the checker's claim.
why: Section 12.5 row 2. The containment conjunct only asks that everything DECLARED was delivered; the size comparison is what refuses an extra field arriving in the checker's inputs. Deleting it leaves a guard that passes a delivery of the declared set PLUS the producer's rationale. AD-017 is the decision this enforces, and the detection is off the loader's own record rather than off the checker's claimed read list.
